section_summary: This section records arrangements for Japanese naval transports to take on petroleum in California and replenish supplies at Honolulu in early 1937. Navy maneuvers led to the cancellation of planned Los Angeles calls and the diversion of SATA and ONDO to San Francisco; HAYATOMO and ERIMO were later scheduled to call at Los Angeles. The latter part concerns Customs reports that ERIMO personnel tried to bring sake and a dwarf pine ashore, and Japanese assurances that the incidents would be investigated.

subfiles.title: Request to Labor concerning ONDO, HAYATOMO and ERIMO
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for three Japanese transports at Los Angeles and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the Ambassador's proposed schedules and asks Labor to extend customary courtesies.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of proposed transport visits
subfiles.about: Acknowledges proposed Los Angeles and Honolulu calls by ONDO, HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the ships' schedules and commanders, and says federal and state authorities have been asked to arrange customary facilities.

subfiles.title: Further reply to the Japanese Ambassador
subfiles.about: Addresses the proposed transport calls and a pending decision on Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Hull tells Saitō that he will communicate again when a decision on the ships' Honolulu visits is reached.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on SATA
subfiles.about: Confirms military authorities were advised of SATA's proposed calls.
subfiles.summary: War officials notified commands in Hawaii and California and requested customary facilities.

subfiles.title: War Department reply on three transports
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions concerning ONDO, HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: The Ninth Corps Area and Hawaiian Department were instructed to extend customary facilities.

subfiles.title: Immigration Service reply on SATA
subfiles.about: Acknowledges SATA's scheduled Los Angeles and Honolulu calls.
subfiles.summary: District directors at both ports are being informed.

subfiles.title: Immigration Service reply on three transports
subfiles.about: Acknowledges proposed visits by ONDO, HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Port directors will extend courtesies consistent with immigration law.

subfiles.title: Telephone communication file note
subfiles.about: Records a telephone communication to the Japanese Embassy about a Navy Department letter.
subfiles.summary: Notes that the letter's substance was relayed to the Embassy.

subfiles.title: Navy objection to Los Angeles calls
subfiles.about: Recommends against Japanese transport calls at Los Angeles during naval maneuvers.
subfiles.summary: Maneuvers in the San Pedro, San Clemente Island and San Diego area make February and early March visits inconvenient. A marginal note says the Navy has no objection to Honolulu calls.

subfiles.title: Request to divert SATA and ONDO to San Francisco
subfiles.about: Requests San Francisco calls after the Los Angeles visits were rejected.
subfiles.summary: Japan canceled HAYATOMO and ERIMO sailings, but SATA and ONDO were already en route. The Ambassador asks whether they may call at San Francisco on their original arrival dates.

subfiles.title: Telegram to California governor on revised calls
subfiles.about: Advises that Los Angeles calls were canceled and SATA and ONDO seek San Francisco calls.
subfiles.summary: Gives February 4–9 and 14–18 dates for the two ships.

subfiles.title: Revised visits: notice to Treasury
subfiles.about: Reports the cancellation of Los Angeles calls and proposed San Francisco calls.
subfiles.summary: SATA and ONDO seek February calls at San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Revised visits: notice to Labor
subfiles.about: Reports the cancellation of Los Angeles calls and proposed San Francisco calls.
subfiles.summary: SATA and ONDO seek February calls at San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Revised visits: notice to Agriculture
subfiles.about: Reports the cancellation of Los Angeles calls and proposed San Francisco calls.
subfiles.summary: SATA and ONDO seek February calls at San Francisco.

subfiles.title: State Department reply to Navy on revised itinerary
subfiles.about: Explains the diversion of SATA and ONDO following the Navy's objection to Los Angeles calls.
subfiles.summary: State has informed Japan that Los Angeles calls are inconvenient. Relying on Navy assurances, it will accept SATA and ONDO at San Francisco and arrange customary facilities.

subfiles.title: Revised visits: notice to War
subfiles.about: Reports the cancellation of Los Angeles calls and proposed San Francisco calls.
subfiles.summary: SATA and ONDO seek February calls at San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Approval of San Francisco calls
subfiles.about: Accepts San Francisco visits by SATA and ONDO.
subfiles.summary: State acknowledges the canceled HAYATOMO and ERIMO sailings and arranges customary facilities for SATA and ONDO, subject to weather affecting their arrival dates.

subfiles.title: Treasury arrangements for SATA
subfiles.about: Confirms Customs authorization for SATA's San Francisco and Honolulu visits.
subfiles.summary: Customs collectors are instructed to extend customary facilities.

subfiles.title: War arrangements for San Francisco calls
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions for SATA and ONDO at San Francisco.
subfiles.summary: The Ninth Corps Area was notified of revised visits and directed to extend customary facilities.

subfiles.title: Hawaii governor's assurance
subfiles.about: Relays Governor Poindexter's assurance about Honolulu calls.
subfiles.summary: Poindexter says customary courtesies will be extended to four Japanese transports.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of renewed HAYATOMO and ERIMO proposal
subfiles.about: Acknowledges proposed March visits by HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: State has consulted interested authorities and promises a further reply.

subfiles.title: Renewed visit request for HAYATOMO and ERIMO
subfiles.about: Requests March Los Angeles and Honolulu calls for HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Provides revised schedules and identifies the ships' captains. The Ambassador asks whether the visits and customary facilities are agreeable.

subfiles.title: March visit request to California governor
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the renewed Los Angeles and Honolulu visit proposal.

subfiles.title: March visit request to Navy
subfiles.about: Seeks Navy concurrence and customary facilities for HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Encloses the Ambassador's February 9 note.

subfiles.title: March visit request to War
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the renewed Los Angeles and Honolulu visit proposal.

subfiles.title: March visit request to Treasury
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the renewed Los Angeles and Honolulu visit proposal.

subfiles.title: March visit request to Labor
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the renewed Los Angeles and Honolulu visit proposal.

subfiles.title: March visit request to Interior
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the renewed Los Angeles and Honolulu visit proposal.

subfiles.title: March visit request to Agriculture
subfiles.about: Requests customary facilities for HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Forwards the renewed Los Angeles and Honolulu visit proposal.

subfiles.title: Treasury arrangements for three transports
subfiles.about: Reports Customs instructions for ONDO, HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Collectors at Los Angeles, Honolulu and San Francisco received instructions reflecting itinerary changes.

subfiles.title: Treasury arrangements for renewed visits
subfiles.about: Authorizes Customs facilities for HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Collectors at Los Angeles and Honolulu were instructed to extend customary facilities.

subfiles.title: War arrangements for renewed visits
subfiles.about: Confirms military instructions for HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Commands in California and Hawaii were told to extend customary facilities.

subfiles.title: HAYATOMO delay notice
subfiles.about: Reports revised dates for HAYATOMO.
subfiles.summary: The ship now expects Los Angeles March 21–25 and Honolulu April 6–9.

subfiles.title: HAYATOMO delay notice to California
subfiles.about: Reports HAYATOMO's revised Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.
subfiles.summary: The Ambassador's February 25 schedule replaces the earlier March dates.

subfiles.title: HAYATOMO delay notice to Agriculture
subfiles.about: Reports HAYATOMO's revised Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.
subfiles.summary: The Ambassador's February 25 schedule replaces the earlier March dates.

subfiles.title: HAYATOMO delay notice to Interior
subfiles.about: Reports HAYATOMO's revised Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.
subfiles.summary: The Ambassador's February 25 schedule replaces the earlier March dates.

subfiles.title: HAYATOMO delay notice to Labor
subfiles.about: Reports HAYATOMO's revised Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.
subfiles.summary: The Ambassador's February 25 schedule replaces the earlier March dates.

subfiles.title: HAYATOMO delay notice to Navy
subfiles.about: Reports HAYATOMO's revised Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.
subfiles.summary: The Ambassador's February 25 schedule replaces the earlier March dates.

subfiles.title: HAYATOMO delay notice to Treasury
subfiles.about: Reports HAYATOMO's revised Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.
subfiles.summary: The Ambassador's February 25 schedule replaces the earlier March dates.

subfiles.title: HAYATOMO delay notice to War
subfiles.about: Reports HAYATOMO's revised Los Angeles and Honolulu dates.
subfiles.summary: The Ambassador's February 25 schedule replaces the earlier March dates.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of HAYATOMO delay
subfiles.about: Acknowledges HAYATOMO's revised schedule.
subfiles.summary: State says the interested departments and California governor have been informed.

subfiles.title: Approval of HAYATOMO's revised calls
subfiles.about: Approves HAYATOMO's revised calls at Los Angeles and Honolulu.
subfiles.summary: Customary courtesies and facilities will be extended.

subfiles.title: Immigration reply on renewed visits
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions for HAYATOMO and ERIMO personnel.
subfiles.summary: District directors will offer courtesies consistent with immigration law.

subfiles.title: Approval of HAYATOMO and ERIMO visits
subfiles.about: Approves proposed visits by HAYATOMO and ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Consulted authorities find the calls agreeable and will extend customary facilities.

subfiles.title: Navy concurrence in renewed visits
subfiles.about: Confirms Navy has no objection to HAYATOMO and ERIMO visits.
subfiles.summary: Naval commanders have been notified to extend customary facilities.

subfiles.title: War acknowledgment of HAYATOMO delay
subfiles.about: Confirms notification of revised HAYATOMO visit dates.
subfiles.summary: California and Hawaii commands were advised of the changed schedule.

subfiles.title: HAYATOMO early-arrival notice
subfiles.about: Reports HAYATOMO will arrive at Los Angeles one day earlier.
subfiles.summary: Arrival changes to March 20; the remaining itinerary is unchanged.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of early arrival
subfiles.about: Acknowledges HAYATOMO's March 20 arrival.
subfiles.summary: Interested federal departments have been advised.

subfiles.title: California governor's acknowledgment
subfiles.about: Acknowledges notice of HAYATOMO's delayed sailing and visits.
subfiles.summary: Merriam notes the revised Los Angeles and Honolulu schedule.

subfiles.title: Immigration acknowledgment of revised dates
subfiles.about: Confirms port directors were informed of HAYATOMO's revised dates.
subfiles.summary: Immigration courtesies remain subject to applicable laws and regulations.

subfiles.title: File memorandum on earlier sake smuggling
subfiles.about: Records advice to Customs collector Cohn about sake smuggling from Japanese tankers.
subfiles.summary: Cohn was asked to approach the Japanese Consul first and report any continuing trouble.

subfiles.title: Cohn's report on ERIMO liquor incidents
subfiles.about: Reports suspected sake smuggling from ERIMO and encloses his letter to the consul.
subfiles.summary: Cohn describes a nighttime attempt to carry sake ashore and says he will report developments.

subfiles.title: Customs complaint to Japanese Consul
subfiles.about: Details attempts to take sake ashore from ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Customs stopped two boxes of sake and observed another four cases returned to the ship when inspectors approached. Cohn asks the consul to impress U.S. regulations upon ship commanders.

subfiles.title: Moore's reply to Cohn on liquor incidents
subfiles.about: Acknowledges reports of attempted liquor smuggling from ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: State is raising the incidents with the Japanese Ambassador and requesting preventive measures.

subfiles.title: Notice to Treasury of liquor incidents
subfiles.about: Forwards correspondence on ERIMO crew members' attempted liquor smuggling.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Customs correspondence and State's note requesting Japanese action.

subfiles.title: Protest to Japanese Ambassador about ERIMO
subfiles.about: Requests action to prevent further Customs violations by Japanese naval crews.
subfiles.summary: Hull recounts earlier warnings and encloses Cohn's account of sake brought ashore at San Pedro on March 8. He asks Japan to prevent similar offenses at U.S. ports.

subfiles.title: Treasury confirmation of HAYATOMO date changes
subfiles.about: Confirms revised HAYATOMO dates were sent to Customs collectors.
subfiles.summary: Los Angeles and Honolulu collectors were notified.

subfiles.title: Telephone memorandum on Japanese reaction
subfiles.about: Records Okazaki's report of Japan's response to the ERIMO incidents.
subfiles.summary: Okazaki says Japanese naval authorities expressed regret and would investigate after ERIMO returned to Japan. He expects a formal reply and assurances against recurrence.

subfiles.title: Assistant Secretary's routing note to Dooman
subfiles.about: Returns two letters for consideration and action.
subfiles.summary: Says three earlier letters were signed.

subfiles.title: Handwritten file note
subfiles.about: Contains a largely illegible handwritten note on correspondence handling.
subfiles.summary: The surviving OCR does not establish its instructions.

subfiles.title: Question about Cohn's earlier letter
subfiles.about: Asks what was done with an earlier letter from Cohn.
subfiles.summary: Requests the letter's disposition.

subfiles.title: Cohn forwards further ERIMO reports
subfiles.about: Forwards Customs reports on a March 13 incident involving ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Encloses three enforcement reports.

subfiles.title: Deputy collector's report on boxed tree
subfiles.about: Reports a confrontation over a box taken ashore from ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Ship officers resisted inspection and summoned armed seamen. The box held a dwarf pine, which Customs ordered returned aboard.

subfiles.title: Patrol inspectors' account of attempted tree landing
subfiles.from: Alfred M. Nuckols and George Hudspeth
subfiles.about: Describes Customs officers stopping a boxed dwarf pine from ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: The officers say ship personnel called the box wine, resisted inspection and tried to reclaim it. Once opened, it proved to contain a dwarf pine and was sent back aboard.

subfiles.title: Guard Miller's account of attempted tree landing
subfiles.about: Reports an altercation during inspection of a box from ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: Miller says ship officers claimed the box held wine, called guards when Customs sought to inspect it, and returned the dwarf pine aboard after its discovery.

subfiles.title: Cohn forwards further consular correspondence
subfiles.about: Encloses correspondence with the Japanese Consul on the March 13 incident.
subfiles.summary: Forwards Cohn's new letter and the consul's reply to his earlier complaint.

subfiles.title: Cohn's complaint about dwarf pine incident
subfiles.about: Complains about ERIMO officers' attempt to land a dwarf pine.
subfiles.summary: Cohn describes resistance to Customs inspection, including an armed sentry, and says the captain later admitted the concealment violated regulations.

subfiles.title: Japanese Consul's reply to Cohn
subfiles.about: Expresses regret over incidents involving Japanese naval tankers.
subfiles.summary: The consul promises to urge captains to observe Customs regulations and prevent further abuses.

subfiles.title: Moore's acknowledgment of further Customs reports
subfiles.about: Acknowledges additional information on ERIMO personnel evading Customs laws.
subfiles.summary: Thanks Cohn for his letters and enclosures.

subfiles.title: Division recommendation on further representations
subfiles.about: Assesses whether to send another written protest about ERIMO.
subfiles.summary: The division recommends waiting for Japan's promised reply, given Okazaki's assurances and the Embassy's awareness of the incidents.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Okazaki about ERIMO
subfiles.about: Records discussion of the dwarf pine incident and the use of armed seamen.
subfiles.summary: Turner describes the Customs reports and stresses the seriousness of armed personnel obstructing U.S. officers. Okazaki, speaking for the Ambassador, promises no repetition, discipline for those involved and reports to Japan.
